Naaber is an overly talkative human who can be found in Carm's Garms at X: 23 Y: 131.
“
Hello! Hi! Over here! Me!
„
— Naaber

Involvement

Upon entering the shop, Naaber tries to get the party's attention by hollering and running towards the party. If he is ignored, Naaber follows the party around [1] and continues to pester them until engaged. However, he stays inside the shop or nearby vicinity.

Naaber is an aspiring adventurer, but has not yet decided what class he should be. The party must keep re-engaging and talking to him long enough until he goes through all the classes (except druid, which is replaced with a dog). In the end, he has an epiphany, that multiclassing is a thing and concludes that he is a genius. On completing this miniquest, Naaber is thankful for the conversation and rewards the party.

The order in which Naaber tries classes is: Fighter; Barbarian; Bard; Cleric; Dog; Wizard; Warlock; Monk; Rogue; Ranger; Sorcerer; and Paladin.

Family

Naaber hails from a long line of talkative Noobers, who have also appeared in previous Baldur's Gate games. Using Speak with Dead on Naaber reveals that Noober is his great-grandfather, Nuuber (possibly Nüber) his grandfather and Niiber (possibly Neeber) his father.

  •  Noober was the first of his kind, an annoyingly talkative man in the town of Nashkel in the first Baldur's Gate game. His name is a play on a slang word 'Noob'. He follows the party spamming dialogue windows until either waiting out all of his dialogue lines or killing him. This gives the party a reward in experience.
  •  Neeber appears in Baldur's Gate II: Shadows of Amn, in the town of Trademeet.
  •  Nüber can be met in Baldur's Gate: Siege of Dragonspear.

Loot

  • If killed, a tiny amount of gold can be looted.

Related quests

Naaber has an unmarked quest:

  • Patience is a Virtue: We did the impossible - we listened to Naaber until he ran out of questions.

Quest rewards

  • Absolute Confidence Amulet

If the amulet was pickpocketed, he will instead reward:

  • Seemingly Gleaming Ring

Speak with Dead

As Naaber cannot stop talking, Naaber can answer more than the usual 5 questions. Also, the caster cannot leave the conversation without having asked at least 3 questions; the Narrator will mention that "The spell's power wanes - but the spirit refuses to be silent."

  • Who are you?
    • Naaber
      I'm... Naaber...
    • Naaber
      Son of... Niiber... son of... Nuuber...
    • Naaber
      Descendant... of... Noober...
    • Naaber
      Nice to... meet... you...
    • Naaber
      Sorry not... to have... met you... properly... when I... was... still alive...
    • Naaber
      Oh the... conversations... we could... have had...
  • What were you doing before you died?
    • Naaber
      I was... trying... to become...
    • Naaber
      An adventurer... but I... couldn't... figure out... what... kind...
    • Naaber
      Always... fancied myself... a bit of... a bard...
    • Naaber
      You... even... encouraged... me... (if encouraged to be a Bard)
    • Naaber
      But I... don't know... how to... play... an instrument...
    • Naaber
      I guess... we'll never... find out... now...
    • Naaber
      Shame... the stories... I could... have told...
  • Did you find your calling?
    • Naaber
      Yes... I want to... be...
    • Naaber
      Alive... But now... that I'm... dead...
    • Naaber
      I will... have... to... try... even... harder... to be... heard...
  • What was your profession before you tried to be an adventurer?
    • Naaber
      Once... I tried... to be... a shopkeeper...
    • Naaber
      But... I never... made... enough... sales...
    • Naaber
      I... never... understood... why... though...
    • Naaber
      I... had... so many... nice... conversations... with... the customers...
    • Naaber
      I... told... them... everything... there was... to know... about... the... produce...
    • Naaber
      But... they... never... came... back...
    • Naaber
      And that's... how I realised... I wasn't... supposed... to be... a shopkeeper...
  • Do you have any regrets?
    • Naaber
      My... only... wish...
    • Naaber
      Was... to... make... friends..
    • Naaber
      And... I... met... you...
    • Naaber
      So... I have... no... regrets...
  • Have you always been so talkative?
    • Naaber
      My... father... learned... from his father... who learned... from his father...
    • Naaber
      That... we... have... to be... persistent...
    • Naaber
      He always... said... if at first... people don't... listen...
    • Naaber
      Keep... trying... and trying...
    • Naaber
      And... trying... and... trying...
    • Naaber
      And... trying... and... trying...
    • Naaber
      Ha... ha... us... Noobers... sure do... like... to talk...
  • Has anyone ever told you you're really annoying?
    • Naaber
      Many... people...
    • Naaber
      Many... times...
    • Naaber
      But... I... try not... to... let it... get... to me...
    • Naaber
      I've... always... been... upbeat...
    • Naaber
      I... don't... understand... why... everyone... else... isn't... the same... way...
    • Naaber
      Isn't it... lovely... to talk... to someone...?
  • Will you ever shut up?
    • Naaber
      Maybe... some day...
    • Naaber
      But... not... today...
    • Naaber
      Did... I... ever... tell... you... about... that... time... I tried... to be... a chef?
    • Naaber
      It... was... three... years... ago... but... I... remember it... like... yesterday...
    • Naaber
      First... I tried... to be... a... pastry... chef...
    • Naaber
      But... butter... gives me... gas...
    • Naaber
      Then... I... tried... to... specialise... in... fish...
      • Narrator
        "Time passes. You can practically feel your hairs growing, and your eyes watering from trying to stay awake."
        • Naaber
          And... that's... how... I... realised... that... being a... chef... wasn't... for me...
  • How do I make this stop?
    • Narrator
      *The corpse remains silent. It does not know.*
  • Leave. (if no questions asked)
    • Naaber
      Wait... we have... only... just... started... talking...
  • Leave. (if one question asked)
    • Naaber
      Don't... leave... yet...
  • Leave. (if two questions asked)
    • Naaber
      Don't... you... want... to... know... more...
    • Naaber
      About... my... life?
  • Leave. (if three questions asked)
    • Naaber
      Why... are... you... leaving... me...
    • Naaber
      I... have so much... more... to tell... you...
      • Narrator
        "His body longs to rest, but his spirit doesn't stop talking, even as he returns to what one can only hope are the deepest depths of the Hells."

Notes

  1. ↑ Naaber does not always approach the party first, nor does he always follow them around. For example, if first approached by a fighter and choosing the conversation option, "Here's a tip from a real fighter - less talking, more fighting." Naaber comments on finding something to punch, ends the conversation and remains by the tall mirror. If he does not follow the party, further interactions can still be held with him there, progressing through all the class options and (eventually) earning the unmarked quest.
